source_snapshot.procedure: Test connections between HMC I2C-7 and second HPM.
source_snapshot.criteria: HMC can successfully communicate with I2C devices on second HPM.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_HMCbus7; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes a BMC-console scan for an explicitly HMC-owned second-HPM path.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for HMC/BMC ownership/proxy, 2P/HPM1 topology, HPM1-specific identities, safe transactions, photos and recovery.

old_problem: A BMC I2C-7 scan may be unrelated to HMC I2C-7, and repeated HPM address layouts can make HPM0 evidence look valid for HPM1. The project does not define controller ownership, proxy semantics or the target-bound second-HPM access route.
disposition_reason: This row's distinguishing coverage is the HMC-owned second-HPM path. Without an authoritative HMC-native endpoint or exact BMC proxy mapping, neither the command target nor recovery is known; device parameters alone cannot repair that semantic gap. HPM1 must also be disambiguated from HPM0. Pending therefore remains rather than fabricating a bus target.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2162, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2163 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00050-V002 / 57ce0199e2240080 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Approve HMC versus BMC ownership and native-HMC or specification-backed proxy access to logical HMC I2C-7.
Prove the 2P/HPM1 population and bind the HMC endpoint/controller/mux/channel to the second-HPM connector.
Bind HPM1-specific identities distinct from HPM0 and a safe read-only transaction allowlist only after the target path is established.
Operator photos prove physical population but cannot validate an unmapped management command or wrong mux channel.
Reject literal bus-number inference, independent BMC/host evidence, HPM0 substitution, generic scan, write, reset and retry.
No HMC/BMC query, physical manipulation, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HMC-owned I2C-7 second-HPM 2P physical and identity validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the authoritative HMC I2C-7 path reaches the physically populated second HPM in the approved 2P state and independently returns all required HPM1 identities.
required_package: Approved HMC/BMC ownership and native-HMC or exact proxy access specification
2P population and HMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/HPM1 connector map
HPM1-specific device address and read-safe identity register/value allowlist distinct from HPM0
Operator physical inspection/photos and trusted management access
Management/bus error limits, abort and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Perform no bus query until HMC ownership and the exact native/proxy HPM1 path are approved. Then operator proves 2P/second-HPM population and only the signed HMC-path read-only method may collect HPM1-specific responses plus bus-health evidence; reject HPM0 or independent BMC results.
test_case.expected_result: The approved HMC path, 2P/HPM1 population and physical connection are proven; every expected HPM1 identity is returned on the exact second-HPM channel with clean management/bus health and no wrong-HPM substitution.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until controller/access and HPM1 target identity are authoritative. PASS requires physical proof plus complete HMC-path HPM1 reconciliation. FAIL on HPM0/wrong path, missing/mismatched device or management fault. Missing ownership/proxy remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until HMC ownership/proxy, HPM1 topology, safe allowlist and recovery are signed.
No unmapped BMC/host substitution, HPM0 reuse, generic scan, write, blind reset or retry.
Stop on wrong-path response, timeout, stuck bus, error storm or HMC/BMC instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and HMC/BMC ownership/proxy diagram
2P/HPM1 population proof and second-HPM connector photos
HMC endpoint/controller/mux/channel/HPM1 map and distinct identity allowlist
Approved method, path-selection proof and complete HPM1 comparison
Pre/post HMC/BMC/I2C errors and management health
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on wrong-path or bus failure. Use only the mapped HMC/BMC recovery; do not rescan, write or blindly reset. Quarantine and escalate if HPM1 selection or restored management state cannot be proven.
